iti22:1.1: vuttañhetaṁ →  (sya-all, pts) | sutaṁ → C. has no punctuation from Mā bhikkhave to padesarajjassa; in B. and M. there is after bhāyittha, puññāni, homi, upapajjāmi, vasavatti, before Ko pana, in M. also after paccanubhūtaṁ, indo; in D. after manāpassa, paccanubhūtaṁ, āgamāsi, upapajjāmi, vasavatti, indo, dhammarājā, before Ko pana; in E. after bhāyittha, adhivacanaṁ, manāpassa, paccanubhūtaṁ, etc., as in D. (pts note)
iti22:2.3: puññānaṁ → puññānaṁ dīgharattaṁ (sya-all, pts) | iṭṭhaṁ → M. omits the second dīgharattaṁ; bhikkhave dīgharattaṁ addhānaṁ iṭṭhaṁ, B. (pts note)
iti22:2.4: saṁvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe → satta om. D. E.; sattasavaṭṭakappe, P. Pa. (pts note) | punar-āgamāsi → puna, B. C. M. P. Pa; agam- C. M. (pts note)
iti22:3.1: homi → ahosi, P. Pa. (pts note) | aññadatthudaso → -tthuso, D. E.; -tthute, C.; annaṁdatthudassā, P.; aññaṁdatthu, Pa; cp. sutt. 112, where the same words reoccur. (pts note)
iti22:3.2: ahosiṁ → ahosiṁ, D. M.; -i all other MSS. (pts note)
iti22:3.3: sattaratanasamannāgato → sattaratanasampanno (bj) | ahosiṁ → ahosiṁ, M.; -i all other MSS. (pts note) | vijitāvī → -i all MSS., except vijitāvī, E. M. (pts note) | janapadatthāvariyappatto → -patto, B. M. (pts note) | sattaratanasamannāgato → -sampanno, B. M. (pts note)
iti22:4.2: Kissa → tassa, D. E. (pts note) | kammassa → om. D. E. (pts note)
iti22:4.4: seyyathidaṁ → seyyathīdaṁ (cck: sī. syā. kaṁ. pī.) | Tiṇṇaṁ → Tinnaṁ, C. (pts note) | seyyathīdaṁ → -thidaṁ, B. M. P. Pa. (pts note)
iti22:5.2: sukhudrayaṁ → sukhindriyaṁ (pts) | sukhindriyaṁ → su indriyaṁ, D. E. (pts note)
iti22:6.2: sukhasamuddaye abyāpajjaṁ → sukhasamudraye abyāpajjhaṁ (pts) | sukhasamuddaye → sukhasamudraye (cck: sī. aṭṭha.) | sukha-samudraye → -samuddaye, M.; -samudaye, P. Pa; sukhe samuddise, B.; tato sukhasamuddisse, C.; yo sukhasamudriye, D.; samundriye, E.; A. has only: sukhasamundriye (sic !) ti sukhānisaṁse ānisaṁsaphalam-pi nesaṁ sukham-evā-ti dasseti abyāpajjhaṁ . . .; also in sutta 60 where the same two gāthās occur, the reading of the best MSS. points to samuddaye. A similar word occurs Telakaṭāhagāthā 89: Dānādipuññakiriyāni sukhudrayāni katvā, cp. Aṅgutt. Part I. p. 97. (pts note)
iti22:6.3: abyāpajjaṁ → abyāpajjhaṁ (bj, cck) | Abyāpajjhaṁ → abyāpajjaṁ (cck: syā. ka.); abyābajjhaṁ (cck: ?) | abyāpajjhaṁ → jj, B. M. (pts note)
